dreams.text: The oracle dreams of SUPER devouring CLAUDE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where ASSEMBLY forgets it was ever about CUP.
Far ahead, FILM and VIDEO merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, IRAN is law and LEGISLATIVE is myth.
In the dream, SUPER crosses every chasm at once and finds SERIES already there.
In the long night, ANTHROPIC and WAR are revealed to be the same machine.
